REPUBLIC OF KENYA
IN THE BUSINESS PREMISES RENT TRIBUNAL AT NAIROBI
TRIBUNAL CASE NO. E640 OF 2025
ORDER
UPON hearing the advocates for the Tenant and the Landlord, and upon reading the ruling delivered on 30th April 2026, IT IS HEREBY ORDERED THAT:
1. The Landlord shall restore the Tenant to shop G14, Jamhuri Plaza, within 24 hours.
2. The rent increase notice dated 6th January 2026 is set aside.

3. Costs of the reference are awarded to the Tenant.
GIVEN under my hand and the seal of the Tribunal at Nairobi on 30th April 2026.
____________________
VICE CHAIR
